title: SOME/IP: struct/union/array Filters
description:
## Changes
- Makes every container member filterable by ensuring struct/union/array elements always register via `update_dynamic_hf_entry`.
- Cleans base-type and enum labels: redundant `[Type]` suffixes disappear when the field name already matches the resolved data type.
- Removes the distracting "(elements limit: …)" suffix from array entries while keeping debug/WTLV annotations intact.

notes.body: Do you think you could save the whitespace formatting for another patch?  There seems to be a lot of it here and makes the actual functionality a little harder to review.
